subheadline.line1: Quest-On turns generative AI from a cheating tool into a thinking partner.
subheadline.line2: We don't just grade answers. We assess the entire reasoning process.

body.line1: Go beyond rote memorization and capture the thinking process as data.
body.line2: Start for free and experience a smarter way to assess.

chat.heading: AI conversation log
chat.subtitle: The student's conversation with the AI

kang.quote: Moving beyond memorization to immerse students in problem-solving, AI's real-time feedback brings new inspiration to course design.
kang.name: Professor Kang

lee.quote: This is a way to prepare students for the new capabilities demanded in the AI era. I hope more educators will take interest and support it.
lee.name: Professor Lee

kwon.quote: The answer to assessing the thinking process essential in the AI era. an innovative platform with both fairness and explainability.
kwon.name: Professor Kwon
kwon.university: Gyeonggi University of Science and Technology

choi.quote: Quest-On makes the reasoning process visible in ways traditional exams never could, marking the beginning of truly meaningful assessment.
choi.name: Professor Choi
choi.university: Gyeonggi University of Science and Technology

chang.quote: A valuable initiative that is meaningful for both students and professors.
chang.name: Professor Chang

deployment.subtitle: We ran 11 real exams and assignments in undergraduate and graduate courses at 3 universities.

hongik.title: First class at Hongik University
hongik.description: It started in a business course we walked into with our very first build. We watched student reactions and refined the product with the professor, and it has continued for two semesters in a row.
hongik.alt: Students using Quest-On in a Hongik University classroom

donggukMidterm.title: Midterms in two Dongguk University courses
donggukMidterm.description: Our first large scale exam, with more than 100 students writing answers on laptops. The team stayed at the front of the classroom until the exam was over.
donggukMidterm.alt: Students taking a midterm on Quest-On at Dongguk University

sookmyung.title: Guest lecture at Sookmyung Women's University
sookmyung.description: We stood in front of students and shared what Quest-On is and why we started building it.
sookmyung.alt: The Quest-On team giving a guest lecture at Sookmyung Women's University

donggukMba.title: Official MBA exam at Dongguk University
donggukMba.description: Working executives and developers took a credit bearing exam on Quest-On. It was our first step from undergraduate courses into graduate assessment.
donggukMba.alt: Quest-On on the screens of a Dongguk University MBA classroom

koreaExtraCredit.title: Extra credit at Korea University Business School
koreaExtraCredit.description: An optional assignment worth up to 5% of the final grade. The professor expected about ten students, but more than fifty took part.
koreaExtraCredit.alt: Korea University extra credit assignment announcement
